job.title: Livestock Operations Manager
job.description:
The Company
Our client is an established Australian agricultural business with a strong commitment to high-quality livestock production, animal welfare and the responsible management of its land and natural resources. Its regional Victorian operations combine commercial discipline with a long-term focus on business goals.

The Opportunity
Reporting to a senior operational leader, this role holds overall responsibility for the leadership, management and performance of our client’s operation. Combining strategic oversight with visible, hands-on leadership, you will coordinate people, livestock, land, infrastructure and resources to deliver safe, efficient and sustainable operational outcomes.
  • Develop and deliver annual operating plans, budgets and seasonal work programs across the property.
  • Lead the day-to-day management of production across the property.
  • Oversee herd health, nutrition, genetic improvement, livestock records and animal welfare standards
  • Plan rotational grazing, feed budgets, pasture improvement, fodder production and sustainable land management activities
  • Coordinate farm leaders, permanent and seasonal employees, contractors, veterinarians, agronomists and reproduction specialists
  • Ensure fencing, water systems, yards, laneways, buildings and other infrastructure remain safe and fit for purpose
  • Maintain compliance across workplace health and safety, biosecurity, environmental and regulatory requirements
  • Monitor performance, costs and operational risk, provide regular reporting and identify opportunities to improve productivity and efficiency
The Person
You will be an experienced livestock or mixed-farming manager with the judgement, practical capability and leadership presence to oversee a large-scale operation.

Equally important will be your ability to lead and develop people, coordinate specialist advisers and contractors, manage competing priorities and build a positive, accountable and safety-focused culture. You will bring sound budgeting, reporting and problem-solving skills, and a practical continuous-improvement mindset.

For a confidential discussion, please contact Ryan Hoiberg at Rimfire Resources on 1300 380 701. To apply, submit your resume and a brief cover letter outlining your relevant experience.

job.title: Senior Administration Officer
job.description:
The Company

Grains Australia delivers functions critical to the success of the Australian grains industry, including trade and market access, classification, market insights, market education and technical market solutions.

Working across the grains value chain, the organisation takes a collaborative “Team Australia” approach to prioritising initiatives and delivering value for growers, industry and customers. Grains Australia offers a professional and supportive workplace built around collaboration, practical leadership and shared responsibility. Grains Australia is an initiative of the Grains Research and Development Corporation (GRDC).

The Opportunity

Grains Australia is seeking an experienced Senior Administration Officer to help keep its business operations running smoothly. This is a hands-on and trusted role for an organised, proactive administrator who enjoys taking ownership, coordinating across the business and following matters through to completion.

Reporting to the Chief Financial Officer, you will provide high-quality administration and coordination support across facilities, IT, projects, travel, meetings and general business operations. This is a fulltime, permanent, office-based position, with some level of flexibility e.g. school drop-offs.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Coordinate and track property and facilities maintenance requests through to resolution
  • Maintain accurate records and provide clear updates on support activities
  • Provide coordination support to projects and business units, including document preparation, reporting inputs and action tracking
  • Support calendars, meetings and general administration to enable efficient day-to-day operations
  • Support complex international travel arrangements
  • Support workplace health and safety documentation and action tracking
  • General office management and coordination duties
The Person
  • Demonstrated experience in a senior administration or coordination role
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities
  • High attention to detail with reliable follow-through
  • Confidence working with internal and external stakeholders
  • Well-developed written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong Microsoft 365 skills, including Outlook, Word, Excel and Teams
  • Ability to work autonomously while collaborating effectively across teams
  
* Experience coordinating facilities, property, travel or external service providers will be highly regarded.

On Offer

This is an opportunity to join an organisation supporting a stronger and more competitive Australian grains industry, while contributing in a varied role offering autonomy, responsibility and meaningful impact. The organisation offers a professional, supportive workplace with a strong emphasis on collaboration, practical leadership and shared responsibility. There is a genuine focus on development, learning and helping people succeed, making it an environment where experienced professionals can contribute, grow and feel valued.

To Apply

For a confidential discussion, contact Charles Linton on 1300 380 701. Applications should include a current resume and brief cover letter and be submitted via www.rimfireresources.com.au

job.title: Chief Finance & Operations Officer
job.description:
The Client

Heiniger Australia is a market-leading, Swiss-owned organisation with a reputation for quality, innovation and strong customer relationships. Heiniger operates in multiple industries including agriculture, horticulture, animal grooming and, recently, the human hair sector. Following a recent executive leadership transition, the organisation is seeking an accomplished Chief Finance & Operations Officer to provide strategic, commercial and operational leadership across its Australian, New Zealand and Malaysian operations.

Reporting directly to the Chief Executive Officer while working closely with the Board, this newly shaped role combines strategic financial leadership with broad operational responsibility across supply chain, inventory, warehousing, HR, IT, business systems and continuous improvement initiatives. This is a rare opportunity for an executive who enjoys strategic execution, who wants to play a significant role in shaping the future direction of a successful international business.

The Opportunity

As a key member of the executive leadership team, you will provide trusted commercial advice to the CEO, Board and senior stakeholders while ensuring the operational foundations of the business remain strong, efficient and scalable. You will oversee an experienced finance function while leading operational activities that support business performance across Australia and New Zealand.

The role will also play a pivotal part in integrating an international acquisition, driving operational excellence and identifying opportunities to leverage emerging technologies, including AI, to improve efficiency and decision-making. Success in this position will come from your ability to combine strategic thinking with a practical, hands-on leadership style and a genuine interest in understanding all facets of the business. It also serves as the primary financial interface with Heiniger’s Group CFO in Switzerland.

This position is based in Perth, Western Australia, with interstate and international travel as required.

Key Responsibilities
  • Provide executive leadership across finance, operations and corporate services functions.
  • Lead financial governance, reporting, risk management and business performance activities. This includes oversight of budgeting, taxation, audit, cashflow management and funding.
  • Partner with the CEO on strategic planning, commercial decision-making and organisational growth.
  • Drive operational excellence across inventory management, warehousing, logistics and business systems.
  • Lead the integration of an international acquisition into existing business operations.
  • Oversee HR and IT governance, ensuring effective support structures and processes are in place.
  • Identify and implement opportunities for technology-enabled efficiencies and process improvement.
  • Develop strong relationships with customers, suppliers, industry stakeholders and the global parent company.
  • Coach, mentor and lead a diverse team while fostering a collaborative, high-performance culture.
About You

You are an experienced CA/CPA qualified executive who translates financial information into practical business decisions, strengthen operational performance and ensuring that the organisation’s systems, people and resources are aligned with its future growth strategy.
You will ideally bring:
  • Significant leadership experience in finance, operations, commercial or general management roles.
  • Strong financial management, governance and risk capability.
  • The ability to oversee multiple business functions and priorities simultaneously.
  • Demonstrated success improving operational performance and business efficiency.
  • Experience leading and developing teams within a values-driven culture.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
  • Strong commercial judgement and strategic thinking capability.
  • The confidence to challenge ideas constructively and contribute meaningfully at executive level.
  • Relevant tertiary qualifications and professional credentials.
Experience within agribusiness, manufacturing, FMCG, distribution, logistics or similarly operational environments, will be highly regarded.

On Offer

On offer is an executive leadership role with broad influence across the organisation and direct partnership with an experienced and highly engaged CEO. An attractive executive package will be negotiated with the successful candidate, including a competitive base salary, performance incentives and a fully maintained vehicle.

To Apply

For more information, call Charles Linton on 1300 380 701 in confidence or apply via www.rimfireresources.com.au

job.title: General Manager of Supply Chain
job.description:
The Company
Our client is a leading, large-scale horticultural business with integrated operations across farming, advanced packing facilities, cold storage, and domestic and export distribution. With a diverse multi-season operating footprint, the business is focused on operational excellence, sustainable produce supply, and continued growth.

The Opportunity
Reporting directly to the Chief Commercial Officer, this newly created executive position is based in regional Victoria. As General Manager of Supply Chain, you will own the end-to-end supply chain execution from crop estimate to final customer delivery encompassing fruit storage, packing schedules, procurement and freight.
As a central pillar of the commercial leadership team, you will establish and run a disciplined, binding S&OP / IBP process, bridging farm operations, packing facilities, sales and marketing.
Key responsibilities include:
  • Accountable for the design, cadence, and output of the S&OP / IBP process across all commodities and sites, maintaining a single aligned plan spanning harvest, packing, cold storage and demand.
  • Establishing allocation rules that align crop packout curves with market windows, customer commitments, and packaging formats, while reducing product directed to juice and minimising waste.
  • Owning and managing total cost-to-market per tonne across freight, packaging, dry goods, internal cartage and third-party logistics against budget baselines.
  • Overseeing procurement governance, competitive tender processes, contract registers, rate reviews and supplier performance across major spend categories.
  • Managing domestic and export logistics across sea and air freight, including protocol market compliance (DAFF requirements, orchard and packhouse accreditations and cold chain standards).
  • Managing controlled atmosphere store loading, sealing, release decisions, and container/pallet pooling arrangements to preserve shelf life and outturn quality.
  • Establishing master data governance across core systems, building advanced reporting and decision support capabilities, and elevating the supply chain from reactive execution to a scalable, best-practice operating model.
About You
The ideal candidate will be a commercially astute, data-driven supply chain leader who performs effectively in a fast-paced, seasonal environment and can maintain a clear, evidence-based position when priorities compete or operating pressure increases.
To be successful in this role, you will bring:
  • A relevant tertiary qualification in Supply Chain Management, Planning, Business, or an aligned discipline.
  • A minimum of ten years of senior supply chain leadership experience within FMCG, fresh produce, food processing, meat, dairy, or cold-chain environments.
  • Proven experience designing, implementing, and running mature S&OP / IBP processes in a multi-site setting.
  • Deep technical capability across domestic and international logistics, export market protocols, cold-chain management and procurement governance.
  • Strong analytical, data-reconciliation, and critical-thinking skills (proficiency with MS Office and BI tools such as Power BI or Tableau).
  • Outstanding cross-functional leadership and communication skills, with the ability to influence farming, site operations, and commercial sales teams alike.
  • High resilience, adaptability, and an operational focus on continuous improvement and bench-strength building.
Why This Role
This is a high-impact leadership opportunity to shape and scale an end-to-end agricultural supply chain, build organisational capability, and deliver measurable improvements in service, cost, quality, and operational resilience.
For a confidential discussion, contact Charles MacCallum on 1300 380 701 . Applications can be submitted via www.rimfireresources.com.au

job.title: Technical Development Manager - Southern Region
job.description:
The Company

LongReach Plant Breeders, a joint venture between Advanta Seeds and Syngenta, is one of Australia’s leading wheat breeding and commercialisation companies. For more than a quarter of a century, the business has conducted research, developed new products and introduced technologies that ultimately improve grower profitability.

With a strong reputation in the Australian grains industry, LongReach continues to build a competitive wheat portfolio through market-led breeding, technical development and commercial partnerships. The business is focused on delivering varieties that meet grower needs, perform in Australian farming systems and support continued growth across the market.

The Opportunity

Reporting to the Commercial Manager, this role will manage LongReach’s product development and advanced line commercialisation across the Southern Region. It is a highly market-facing technical role, supporting the transfer of knowledge between the wheat breeding program, growers, agronomists, advisers and broader industry stakeholders.

The role will ensure new wheat varieties, agronomic practices and research outcomes are effectively evaluated, communicated and adopted across farming systems. Just as importantly, it will bring market, technical and grower feedback back into the breeding program to help shape pipeline and portfolio decisions.

Key areas of focus include:
  • Coordinating product development trials, demonstration sites and variety evaluation activity
  • Translating breeding and research outcomes into practical information for growers and advisers
  • Delivering field days, workshops, technical updates and industry presentations
  • Building relationships with growers, agronomists, consultants, seed companies and industry bodies
  • Supporting product advancement, variety release and commercialisation planning
  • Providing technical, market and farming system feedback to breeders and the commercial team
This position will also play an important role in LongReach’s engagement with the NVT program, grower groups, retail agronomy networks, independent agronomists and key industry events across South Australia and Victoria.

About You

We are seeking a practical, technically strong and relationship-driven grains professional who brings:
  • 5+ years’ experience in cereal agronomy, broadacre cropping or a related technical environment
  • A graduate qualification in agriculture, agronomy or a related discipline
  • Strong knowledge of Southern Region farming systems across South Australia and Victoria
  • Experience in field agronomics, cereal farming methods, disease assessment and trial evaluation
  • An understanding of plant breeding operations, genetics and selection methodologies
  • Strong communication, networking and stakeholder engagement skills
  • The ability to work independently, organise field activity and travel widely across cropping regions
Most importantly, you will be self-motivated, commercially aware and confident working with growers, advisers, researchers and internal teams to turn technical insight into practical value in the paddock.

Why This Role

This is a rare opportunity to join LongReach Plant Breeders in a role that aligns closely to the science, the market and the grower. You will have the chance to influence how new wheat varieties are evaluated, positioned, released and adopted across one of Australia’s most important grain-growing regions.

If you are a technically capable grains professional who enjoys working closely alongside  growers, advisers and industry, we would love to hear from you. For a confidential discussion, contact Ryan Hoiberg on 1300 380 701. Applications via www.rimfireresources.com.au

job.title: Finance Business Partner
job.description:
The Company
Our client is a premier, large-scale horticultural business with extensive operations spanning across farming, state of the art packing facilities, cold storage, and a multi-channel domestic and export distribution network. Operating across a national multi-season footprint, the business is dedicated to operational excellence, sustainable produce supply and continuous growth.

The Opportunity
Reporting directly to the Chief Financial Officer, this high-impact Finance Business Partner position is based in South West WA. The role provides strategic financial leadership, deep analytical insight, and commercial guidance to operational teams across the company’s premier assets and grower networks in Western Australia.

You will partner with farm leaders, production teams and commercial executives, translating financial reporting into practical operational insight. Your advice will support decisions that improve profitability, control costs and prioritise capital investment.
  
Key responsibilities include:
  • Developing detailed block, variety, and planting-age profitability models—tracking growing, harvest, and post-harvest costs per hectare, tonne, and bin across all planted areas.
  • Evaluating sub-breakeven blocks and building comprehensive financial business cases for orchard removal, replanting or retention strategies.
  • Governing capitalised operating expenditure boundaries, immature block schedules, and biological asset/inventory reconciliations to ensure clear visibility between accounting and cash flow impacts.
  • Managing unit-level labour productivity metrics and operational input costs to drive cost convergence across properties.
  • Owning annual budgets, rolling operational forecasts, seasonal working capital models, and capital expenditure tracking across peak harvest windows.
  • Overseeing standalone profit and loss, grower settlement models, and marketing margin allocations under exclusive commercial variety licenses
  • Managing cost-to-serve analysis by sales channel, maintaining license compliance registers, modelling program working capital and assessing counterparty exposure across grower bases.
  • Leading month-end close procedures, entity financial reporting, tax/grant compliance, and external audit support while embedding robust cost-coding discipline.
About You
The ideal candidate will be a commercially astute, CA or CPA qualified finance professional who can translate complex financial information into clear, practical insights for operational leaders.
To be successful in this role, you will bring:
  • CA or CPA qualification with a relevant degree in Accounting, Finance, or Economics.
  • At least five years’ experience, including a minimum of two years in a business partnering role within agricultural, horticultural, food manufacturing or FMCG setting.
  • Proven experience in grower pools, supplier settlement, consignment accounting, or commercial licence and royalty frameworks will be highly regarded.
  • Advanced financial modelling capabilities with the ability to independently build robust 5-year business cases and capital proposals.
  • Demonstrated track record of identifying, quantifying, and delivering cost reduction initiatives, with measurable impact on financial performance.
  • Strong proficiency with Excel, modern ERP/finance systems and business intelligence tools (Power BI, Tableau).
  • Outstanding interpersonal and communication skills, with the confidence to constructively challenge operational managers and build collaborative relationships.
Why This Role
This high-visibility role offers direct access to senior leaders and meaningful influence over operational strategy, asset development and value creation across a growing horticultural business. It is an opportunity to combine commercial finance expertise with hands-on operational partnering in a complex, multi-site environment.

For a confidential discussion, contact Charles MacCallum on 1300 380 701. To apply, visit www.rimfireresources.com.au

job.title: General Manager PlantJuice & Agricultural Products
job.description:
The Company:
Pacific Bio is an Australian innovation company delivering nature-based solutions at commercial scale across wastewater management, agriculture and biofuels. Known for world-first technology and practical market applications, the business combines scientific capability with a clear focus on affordable, commercially sustainable outcomes.

PlantJuice is an emerging agricultural products platform linked to Pacific Bio’s RegenAqua technology, which produces macroalgal biomass for use as feedstock. With trials, technical evidence and production capability providing a strong foundation, the business is ready for a commercially driven leader to build demand, convert opportunities and create a scalable revenue stream.

The Position:
Reporting directly to the Chief Executive Officer, the General Manager – PlantJuice and Agricultural Products will build an emerging platform into a material, revenue-generating business. This is a hands-on growth role with a strong commercial focus: creating demand, winning customers, developing channels and turning successful trials into repeat sales.
  • Develop and execute the go-to-market strategy across direct, channel and strategic accounts.
  • Lead business development from customer prospecting and trials through to conversion and repeat sales.
  • Build the sales pipeline, pricing, forecasts and commercial performance measures.
  • Turn scientific and field-trial evidence into compelling customer propositions and practical product recommendations.
  • Align production, inventory and delivery with market demand in partnership with RegenAqua and operations teams.
  • Own the business plan and budget, while building the capability required for sustainable growth.
Success will be defined by early market prioritisation, a quantified sales and trial pipeline, sound pricing and margin logic, active customer acquisition and a reliable production-to-customer rhythm.

The Person:
To be successful in this highly rewarding but challenging opportunity, you will be commercially driven and combine market credibility with an entrepreneurial, sleeves-rolled-up approach. You will bring senior sales or commercial leadership experience in agricultural inputs, biologicals, biostimulants, crop nutrition, specialty fertilisers or a closely related sector, together with a record of delivering results and growing revenue.
  • Strong knowledge of Australian agriculture, crop cycles, grower economics and purchasing drivers.
  • Proven success building sales, distribution channels and strategic partnerships.
  • Technical literacy and the ability to convert scientific, agronomic and trial data into practical commercial propositions.
  • Sound financial capability across pricing, margin, forecasting, budgeting and channel economics.
  • Working exposure to production, manufacturing, supply chain and logistics.
  • Experience building a business, team or systems in a start-up, scale-up or fast-growth environment.
  • The judgement and energy to move comfortably between customers, technical detail, strategy and execution.
Melbourne based, the position requires regular interstate travel to customers, agricultural regions and Pacific Bio operating sites. Tertiary qualifications in agriculture, agribusiness, business or a related discipline will be highly valued; however, demonstrated commercial leadership and business-building success will carry greater weight.

This is a rare opportunity to lead the commercial development of an innovative agricultural products platform with the potential to deliver strong customer outcomes, meaningful growth and positive environmental impact.

For further information or a confidential discussion, please call Mick Hay on 1300 380 701. Applications via www.rimfireresources.com.au

job.title: Data Analyst - Horticulture
job.description:
The Company
Avocados Australia is a not-for-profit organisation representing the Australian avocado industry from orchard to consumer. It provides strategic leadership, advocacy, research, market development and practical services to help growers and the broader supply chain remain profitable, competitive and sustainable.

The Opportunity Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer, you will manage the end-to-end capture, validation, analysis and reporting of key avocado industry data. Working as part of a small team you will oversee Avocados Australia’s core data systems and build strong relationships with growers, packhouses, traders and other industry stakeholders across Australia and New Zealand.  
  • Collect weekly and seasonal dispatch and forecast data from packhouses, traders and industry bodies, including regular phone engagement with growers.
  • Manage reporting and produce accurate weekly, quarterly and annual industry reports
  • Validate data for completeness and accuracy, then analyse trends in production, supply, demand, volume and price
  • Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards, including migrating existing PDF reports into interactive formats
  • Prepare professional graphs, presentations, statistics snapshots and tailored reports that help stakeholders interpret industry data
  • Support project planning, milestone reporting, implementation and budget management for the industry data program
About You
This role would suit a capable analyst who enjoys taking ownership of data from collection through to reporting and can turn detailed information into practical insights for a broad industry audience.

We would like to hear from you if you offer:
  • A relevant tertiary qualification in data analytics, economics or a related discipline, backed by proven experience in a similar data collection and analytics role
  • The position requires advanced Excel skills, including the ability to produce clear graphs and reports
  • Strong Power BI capability, including medium to high-level DAX, with experience building and maintaining interactive dashboards
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft SQL, including querying, inserting, updating and altering data
  • Excellent attention to detail and a disciplined approach to data validation, completeness and accuracy
  • The ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines and deliver projects with sound planning and budget awareness
  • A practical, solutions-focused approach, with the ability to identify useful data sources and explain findings clearly
  • You will have the opportunity to use your interpersonal skills to gain cooperation from growers, industry partners, consultants and internal stakeholders
  • High level of organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple activities concurrently, prioritise work and meet deadlines.
A background in economics or commodity markets would be valuable, while experience with a not-for-profit, member-based organisation or exposure to rural and regional communities would also be well regarded.

Why this Role?
This is a hands-on role where your work will help people across one of Australia’s leading horticultural industries make better decisions. You will join a friendly, close-knit team, gain exposure to a wide range of industry data and have room to grow your skills.

The role offers flexible start and finish times, and onsite parking. For a confidential discussion, please call Mark Turner on 1300 380 701. Applications via www.rimfireresources.com.au.

job.title: Transport Scheduler - Grain & Logistics
job.description:
The Company

Our client is a well-established and respected agribusiness operating across grain and logistics services. They play a critical role supporting growers and customers through efficient, compliant and reliable transport operations. With a strong focus on safety, service and continuous improvement, the business offers a supportive team environment and long-term career opportunity.

The Opportunity

Reporting to the Transport Manager, this role is central to the day-to-day coordination of transport operations. You will be responsible for scheduling and allocating trucks in line with customer requirements and National Fatigue Laws, while working closely drivers and the broader transport administration team.
This is a highly engaged, detail-driven role where no two days are the same. You will liaise closely with drivers, customers and internal stakeholders to ensure orders are planned, communicated and delivered efficiently. There is also scope to contribute to improving systems, processes and transport outcomes as the business continues to evolve.

About You

You may already be working in a transport scheduling or logistics coordination role, and ideally you would have a passion for the grain industry and/or Australian agriculture. You may even come from a broader agricultural background with a different skill set, and be ready to step into a more specialised scheduling position.

We would be open to speaking with you if you match the above, and have also:
  • Experience in transport scheduling, logistics or a similar coordination role
  • An understanding of compliance requirements, ideally including fatigue management
  • High attention to detail and strong organisational skills
  • Clear communication skills and the confidence to deal with drivers and customers daily
  • A calm, practical approach in a fast-paced operational environment
Why This Role

This is an excellent opportunity to join a stable and growing agribusiness where your contribution is visible and valued. You will work closely with an experienced team, gain exposure to end-to-end transport operations and play a key role in keeping the business moving.

To discuss this opportunity in confidence, please contact Ryan Hoiberg on 1300 380 701 or apply via www.rimfireresources.com.au

job.title: Chief Executive Officer
job.description:
The Company
Established in 1914, Holstein Australia is the country’s largest dairy cattle breed association and a recognised leader in registration, classification and genetic improvement services. Its Herdbook and Appendix contain records for more than two million animals, supported by around 40,000 new registrations and 30,000 classifications each year.

Representing approximately 900 members, Holstein Australia helps dairy producers improve profitability through world-class information, services and community.

The Opportunity
Reporting to the Chair and Board, the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) will take full responsibility for the day-to-day leadership and management of Holstein Australia. This is a visible, hands-on executive role with a clear mandate.

Working collaboratively with the Board, the CEO will shape strategy, vision and operational plans while leading a small, committed team. Externally, the successful person will be an accessible and credible representative for members, dairy producers, breed organisations, commercial partners and the broader agricultural sector.

Key Priorities
  • Lead all operational matters and create clear accountability across the organisation
  • Partner with the Board to develop and implement strategy, policy and measurable and achievable operational plans
  • Improve financial resilience, diversify of revenue and reduce reliance on volatile live-export income
  • Increase member engagement, service utilisation and confidence through stronger communication
  • Build organisational capability, support the team and address current resourcing priorities
  • Represent Holstein Australia at member activities, industry events and stakeholder forums
  • Manage change associated with structural, regulatory and market developments, including the potential merger
  • Maintain effective governance, budgeting, risk management and Board reporting
About You
You will be a credible and energetic senior leader who combines strategic judgement with the willingness to stay close to operations, members and industry. Commercially minded and relationship-driven, you will be confident and have experience working with a Board.

You may already be an experienced CEO, or a senior general manager or executive ready to step into your first chief executive role. Direct dairy experience will be highly regarded but is not essential; applications are encouraged from adjacent agricultural, livestock, genetics, member-based or industry organisations where you have built stakeholder trust and delivered commercial and organisational change.
  • Senior leadership experience with responsibility for organisational performance
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, including budgeting, performance analysis, reporting and revenue development
  • Experience working with a Board and a sound understanding of governance
  • Proven stakeholder engagement, communication and representation capability ideally in a member based organisation
  • Success leading people, change and organisational improvement
  • A practical, collaborative and accountable leadership style
  • Willingness to travel nationally and maintain a strong presence with members and industry
To Apply
For a confidential discussion, please contact Ryan Hoiberg or David Jackson at Rimfire Resources on 1300 380 701. To apply, submit your resume and a brief cover letter outlining your relevant leadership, commercial and stakeholder experience.

Rimfire Resources specialises in agribusiness recruitment and is managing this executive search on behalf of Holstein Australia. All applications and enquiries will be treated in strict confidence.

job.title: Grains Buyer
job.description:
The Company
Our client is an industry leader in the manufacture of high-quality stockfeed products, supplying customers across Victoria and Southern New South Wales. With a multi-site feed mill network, strong operational capability and a reputation built on safety, quality and consistency, this Australian-owned agribusiness continues to invest in its people, systems and assets to support long-term growth and strengthen its market position

The Opportunity
Working closely with the Grains team leader, you will be responsible for the end to end management of grain contracts and grain procurement, with direction and support to purchase the required raw materials to ensure ongoing production across all facilities. You will be directed regarding approved suppliers and pricing elements to successfully negotiate and purchase products, and then be responsible for overseeing all relevant documentation and contract management.
In this role you will:
  • Negotiate and manage all commodity contracts, from execution to payment and conclusion
  • Manage internal grain inventory levels at each site tracking raw material inventory, usage and forecast requirements
  • Execute Grain Movement Orders
  • Manage and track all contract draw downs and grain storage handling facilities
  • Maintain relationships with grain trade suppliers and develop new business where possible
  • Evaluate and recommend suppliers/vendors
  • Provide market information relating to position and product quality relevant to raw materials to ensure wider team is across market trends and information.
About You

job.description:
The Company
Our client is an industry leader in the manufacture of high-quality stockfeed products, supplying customers across Victoria and Southern New South Wales. With a multi-site feed mill network, strong operational capability and a reputation built on safety, quality and consistency, this Australian-owned agribusiness continues to invest in its people, systems and assets to support long-term growth and strengthen its market position.

The Opportunity
Reporting to the Sales Manager, you will manage an established West and/or South Gippsland territory, servicing an existing customer base while identifying growth opportunities. Working closely with dairy producers, you will build trusted relationships and provide practical production and ruminant nutrition advice that supports long-term customer success.

About You
You bring a strong connection to the dairy industry, experience working with farming customers and sound ruminant nutrition knowledge. You are a capable communicator, comfortable in a sales-focused role and confident managing customer orders, relationships and day-to-day territory activity. Well organised and self-motivated, you can manage your time effectively and provide responsive support when needed.

This is a rare and genuine opportunity to join an organisation which has strong manufacturing and marketing capabilities and a loyal customer base. Salary is negotiable on experience including vehicle and relevant tools of trade. If this is an opportunity you would like to further discuss, please call 1300 380 701 and speak with Ryan Hoiberg, or apply now via the relevant links.
